title: Token Re-Moving
statement: For every root of an n-vertex tree (n up to 5·10^5), the problem wants the total cost of operations in order p, where operating on u gathers its subtree's tokens onto u, costing their count. A vertex pays only if it precedes all its ancestors, so the roots where it pays form its component among later-operated vertices; reverse-order union-find builds a reconstruction tree whose root-path sums give every answer.
